## Constants

<a name="MaximumRotationOverlap"></a>MaximumRotationOverlap bounds the interval that accepts old and new credentials.

```go
const MaximumRotationOverlap = 24 * time.Hour
```

<a name="RecoverAdministrator"></a>
## func [RecoverAdministrator](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/local_recovery.go#L13>)

```go
func RecoverAdministrator(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, id string) (string, error)
```

RecoverAdministrator replaces a lost administrator credential through explicit local filesystem authority. It requires exclusive private state access and a valid audit history. Stop the server first.

<a name="Action"></a>
## type [Action](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/operation.go#L10>)

Action identifies an administrative effect recorded before execution.

```go
type Action string
```

<a name="Bootstrap"></a>

```go
const (
    // Bootstrap creates the first local administrator.
    Bootstrap Action = "bootstrap"
    // CreateIdentity adds an administrator or subscriber.
    CreateIdentity Action = "create_identity"
    // RotateIdentity replaces a credential with a bounded overlap.
    RotateIdentity Action = "rotate_identity"
    // RevokeIdentity withdraws all credentials for an identity.
    RevokeIdentity Action = "revoke_identity"
    // RefreshCatalog starts explicit catalog acquisition.
    RefreshCatalog Action = "refresh_catalog"
    // CancelOperation asks an accepted operation to stop.
    CancelOperation Action = "cancel_operation"
)
```

<a name="Manager"></a>
## type [Manager](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/manager.go#L35-L47>)

Manager owns identities, audit events, and operation receipts for one server. Authentication reads an immutable snapshot. Administrative writes use one process lease.

    // contains filtered or unexported fields

<a name="Initialize"></a>
### func [Initialize](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/manager.go#L51>)

```go
func Initialize(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, administratorID string) (_ *Manager, token string, resultErr error)
```

Initialize creates the first administrator through an explicit local operation. It refuses existing identities and returns the credential only after durable completion.

<a name="Open"></a>
### func [Open](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/manager.go#L93>)

```go
func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (_ *Manager, resultErr error)
```

Open restores private administration state without creating an administrator. Audit failures leave authenticated diagnostics available and reject new mutations.

```go
func (m *Manager) Rotate(ctx context.Context, actor Principal, id string, overlap time.Duration) (string, error)
```

Rotate returns a new credential and retains the prior active key for the selected overlap. A second rotation cannot discard a key whose overlap has not ended.

<a name="Role"></a>
## type [Role](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/identity.go#L17>)

Role separates catalog subscription from server administration.

```go
type Role string
```

<a name="Subscriber"></a>

```go
const (
    // Subscriber can read the catalog within its configured audience.
    Subscriber Role = "subscriber"
    // Administrator can authorize server mutations and read configuration reports.
    Administrator Role = "administrator"
)
```

<a name="State"></a>
## type [State](<https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/blob/main/server/administration/operation.go#L28>)

State records the durable outcome of an administrative operation.

```go
type State string
```

<a name="Accepted"></a>

```go
const (
    // Accepted means the audit intent is durable and effects may start.
    Accepted State = "accepted"
    // Succeeded means the effect and its audit outcome are durable.
    Succeeded State = "succeeded"
    // Failed means the operation reported a failure. Effects can be partial.
    Failed State = "failed"
    // Interrupted means recovery cannot prove the effect's outcome. It never replays the effect.
    Interrupted State = "interrupted"
)
```
